answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 20366 Country: India Title: i want to know that can we colour our hairs? Eg:brown,golden etc. 2) can we use black colour which is available in market to hide our white hairs? i request u to plz give answers to my questions as soon as possible. Question: assalamualikum janab mufti sahab. 1)i want to know that can we colour our hairs? Eg:brown,golden etc. 2) can we use black colour which is available in market to hide our white hairs? i request u to plz give answers to my questions as soon as possible. Answer ID: 20366 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 293/B=51/tb=1431) (1) Colouring only with Menhdi (henna) or red colour is proved. (2) No, according to Hanafi Fiqh, using black colour for hair is makrooh tahrimi . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
